translations.web: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.
translations.bsb: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
translations.kjv: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
translations.asv: Therefore be ye also ready; for in an hour that ye think not the Son of man cometh.
